tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss student recruitment interests and programme expectations
Check and record registration details in the student records system {OTHER}
Discuss placement suitability and refer decisions to the authorised programme staff

tasks.design: Configure the student records system {OTHER} to reuse submitted registration fields and highlight missing entries. The teacher verifies the record and retains recruitment conversations and placement advice; the change makes no admission or placement decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same contact and registration details are checked and entered repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse submitted fields without judging suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding student goals and placement constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Explain programme demands and discuss individual circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less registration entry; placement authority is unchanged.

reach.learn: Registration requirements and placement referral routes

evidence.claim: Native registration forms and field reuse are plausible model knowledge; the digest provides no recruitment or placement saving case.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation, excluding student submission effort and registrar admission decisions. No assessment or ranking is automated.

Student is the existing producer of name, student reference, contact details, programme choice and submission date. Existing student capture remains unchanged; teacher identity checks, missing-field clarification and corrections remain within s2's 24.5 hours. Free-text or absent fields are entered and checked manually.
Test native registration configuration first. Programme staff maintain registration fields; two additional other-role hours are allowed for this upkeep.
research_questions: Does field reuse reduce teacher entry after identity checks and corrections?

approvals.approved_version: Exact student reference, contact details, programme and registration record revision; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+24.5+25=89.5, gross=10.5, upkeep=3, net=7.5. High assumes 30% less registration-stage entry; low assumes irregular submissions require full manual checks. Recruitment and placement discussions retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain attendance, grades and required records

steps.what: Verify attendance observations and authorised grades for required student records
Transfer attendance and grades to the student records system {OTHER}
Reconcile required records and approve the exact student record publication

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} export and the student records system {OTHER} import to stage verified attendance and authorised results. Reconcile roster, assessment version, values and exceptions before publication; no model awards grades.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results may need separate publication in two systems.
tasks.enabler_now: A checked native export/import can remove repeated entry where it remains manual.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect student matches, resits and corrections to already authorised results.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve contradictory attendance or grade evidence before records are published.
tasks.altitude: Less transcription, with unchanged responsibility for the published record.

reach.learn: Record versions, assessment identifiers and exception handling

evidence.claim: Radboud describes grades needing publication in both Brightspace and OSIRIS, supporting the possibility of duplicate record entry, not this saving estimate.
Staging verified records through native import with reconciliation is an E1 design scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is record maintenance after assessment decisions. Grading belongs to a separate task; source verification here must not count the act of grading again.

Teacher produces student ID, course ID, session/date, attendance status, assessment ID/version, authorised result and correction reason in s1; all 40 hours of observation reconciliation and capture remain. Assessment authority produces the underlying approved result through existing unchanged grading work. Missing identifiers or disputed results go to manual correction.

Records administrator produces and checks field mappings including resit and grade scale; allow three other-role upkeep hours. Test native import first, stop unmatched or changed records, and grant no savings if sync already runs.
research_questions: Can a sample including resits and corrections be transferred with no semantic grade changes?

approvals.approved_version: Exact student/course/session and assessment-version result snapshot, attendance values and destinations; any correction requires new approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+25=65, gross=35, upkeep=5, net=30. High requires currently manual duplicate transfer with usable native mappings. Low retains manual transfer for incompatible records and adds upkeep; existing system runtime earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve as department head and perform administration

steps.what: Direct department activities and resolve administrative priorities with colleagues
Record administrative actions and follow up responsible colleagues

tasks.design: Configure an action register in {PROJECT} with teacher-entered owners and deadlines, replacing repeated email chasing where that occurs. The teacher checks actions and recipients and retains department decisions and difficult follow-up conversations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actions and follow-up dates are scattered across messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native task registers support explicit ownership and due-date reminders.
tasks.still_hard: Competing priorities, sensitive staffing matters and unresolved commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Exercise departmental judgement and negotiate commitments.
tasks.altitude: A clearer action register; leadership and decision rights do not change.

reach.learn: Clear action ownership and appropriate escalation

evidence.claim: Native action registers can reduce repeated reminder assembly but cannot replace department leadership; this is model knowledge, without a digest case.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's department-head work, excluding colleague execution and institution-wide administration. The 35-hour follow-up share is a scenario to validate, not an invented universal baseline.

Teacher produces action text, owner, deadline, decision reference, confidentiality and allowed recipient in s2; its 28 remaining hours include capture, checking and sensitive manual follow-up. No structured decision extraction or automatic personnel decision is assumed.
Test native task configuration first; unresolved owners or sensitive content stay in direct conversation. Three focal upkeep hours cover access and reminder checks.
research_questions: Is repeated action chasing material after the register's capture time is included?

already_counted.description: Action capture, recipient check and difficult follow-up

approvals.approved_version: Exact action, owner, due date, confidentiality and recipients; edits require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65+28=93, gross=7, upkeep=3, net=4. High assumes 20% less repetitive follow-up assembly; low assumes leadership and exceptional follow-up fill all prior time. Colleague delivery is unchanged and excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain instructional materials and supplies

steps.what: Select textbooks and supplies against teaching needs and available editions
Assemble the materials requisition from selected items
Check and submit the materials requisition to purchasing staff

tasks.design: Use native {PROCUREMENT} catalogue favourites to populate a requisition from verified item choices. The teacher retains educational selection and checks edition, quantity, cost and delivery before submitting to purchasing staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chosen materials are re-entered into a separate requisition.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue records can fill repetitive fields without selecting teaching content.
tasks.still_hard: Edition suitability, accessibility, licence limits and unavailable items.
tasks.human_edge: Choose materials that fit learners and course outcomes.
tasks.altitude: Less requisition entry; educational choices stay with the teacher.

evidence.claim: Catalogue-based requisition filling is plausible model knowledge; the digest has no instructional purchasing case.

assumptions: Boundary is selection through requisition submission, excluding purchasing approval, delivery and invoice processing.

Teacher produces item or ISBN reference, edition, quantity, required date, course, cost centre and checked price in s1; its full 60 hours include capture and catalogue verification. Purchasing staff maintain supplier and catalogue records under existing work; two additional upkeep hours are allowed. Missing catalogue items use manual requisitions.
Test native favourites and requisitions first. Only currently repeated entry can vanish; catalogue runtime already present earns no saving.
research_questions: Do edition and licence checks leave sufficient repeat entry to justify configuration?

approvals.approved_version: Exact item/edition, quantity, supplier, price, cost centre and required date requisition revision; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+0+15=75, gross=25, upkeep=4, net=21. High requires catalogued items and current repeated requisition entry. Low assumes unusual editions or licences require full manual entry plus upkeep. Selection and purchasing staff work retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeat student-record and requisition entry while retaining teaching, placement advice and department leadership.
reach: Coordinate course records with instructional coordinators
role.ambitious_version: An education teacher with reliable course records and fewer repeated administrative entries, retaining academic decisions and relationships.
